title: Home is Currently Unavailable
shortDescription: Fire TV home screen fails to load with 'Home is currently unavailable'.
fullDescription: Fire TV home pulls recommendations from Amazon servers. DNS, region, or account token issues blank it.
symptoms: Live tab works, Home does not

fixSteps.title: Clear Home cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Applications > Manage Installed Applications > Amazon Home > Clear cache.

faq.a: Fire TV home screen fails to load with 'Home is currently unavailable'.

title: Alexa Voice Remote Not Detected
fullDescription: Hold Home button 10 seconds to re-pair. New batteries usually solve a flaky remote.

fixSteps.title: Add via app
fixSteps.instruction: Use Fire TV app on phone.

title: Overheating Warning
shortDescription: Fire TV stick warm and shows overheating warning.
fullDescription: Use the supplied HDMI extender to lift the stick away from the back of the TV.

faq.a: Fire TV stick warm and shows overheating warning.

title: Wi-Fi Won't Connect
shortDescription: Fire TV cannot save Wi-Fi credentials.
fullDescription: Forget the network and re-add. 5 GHz networks with WPA3 may need WPA2/3 mixed mode on older sticks.

faq.a: Fire TV cannot save Wi-Fi credentials.

title: Netflix NETFLIX UI-800-3
shortDescription: Netflix app shows error NETFLIX UI-800-3 on Amazon Streaming Device, usually cache-related.
fullDescription: Error NETFLIX UI-800-3 indicates a cache problem between the Netflix app and its servers. Most cases clear with a sign-out, app reload, or network reset. Persistent errors may need firmware update or factory reset.

causes.cause: Stale app cache or expired session token
Outdated TV firmware or app version

fixSteps.title: Restart TV
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV for 60 seconds then power back on to clear memory.

fixSteps.title: Sign out and back in
fixSteps.instruction: Open Netflix, sign out, then sign back in to refresh the session token.

fixSteps.title: Check network
fixSteps.instruction: Run network test in TV settings; reboot router if speeds are low.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Support > Software Update; install any pending update.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall app
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the Netflix app from the home screen and reinstall from the store.

whenToCallPro: Only if errors persist after factory reset.

faq.q: Is NETFLIX UI-800-3 a TV hardware fault?
faq.a: No — it is an app/network error and clears with sign-out, reinstall, or firmware update.

title: Sideloaded App Crashes
shortDescription: Sideloaded APK crashes on Fire TV.
fullDescription: Fire OS sandbox restricts sideloaded apps. Reinstall a Fire-TV-targeted APK or grant ADB permissions in Developer options.

causes.cause: APK not built for Fire OS

fixSteps.title: Reinstall
fixSteps.instruction: Use Downloader to reinstall the APK.

faq.a: Sideloaded APK crashes on Fire TV.

title: Cube Far-Field Mic Not Hearing
shortDescription: Fire TV Cube ignores 'Alexa' wake word.
fullDescription: Confirm the mic mute LED is off and Hands-Free is enabled. Privacy mute switch on top disables far-field listening.
videoSearchQuery: Amazon CUBE FAR-FIELD MIC OFF fix

faq.q: What causes CUBE FAR-FIELD MIC OFF?
faq.a: Fire TV Cube ignores 'Alexa' wake word.

title: HDMI CEC Wake Fails
shortDescription: Fire TV does not wake the TV via CEC.
fullDescription: Enable HDMI CEC on TV (named Anynet+/Bravia Sync/Simplink) and set Equipment Control inside Fire TV.

fixSteps.title: Equipment Control
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Equipment Control > Manage Equipment > add TV.

videoSearchQuery: Amazon HDMI CEC WAKE FAIL fix

faq.q: What causes HDMI CEC WAKE FAIL?
faq.a: Fire TV does not wake the TV via CEC.

title: Prime Video Error 1007

fullDescription: Code 1007 is an internet/streaming error. Check connection, restart device, and clear Prime Video cache.

fixSteps.title: Sign out / in
fixSteps.instruction: Sign out and back in to Prime Video.

faq.a: Prime Video playback fails with code 1007.
